Warranties on Goodyear tyres

Every Goodyear tyre

Goodyear warrants its tyres against faults such as a defect in manufacture, processing or material. A valid claim is adjusted pro rata on the tread left: for example, a tyre that still has 6 mm of its original 8 mm tread gets 75% off an equivalent replacement.

  • The tyre must be bought new from an authorised Goodyear dealer in Australia, not a parallel import.
  • Keep your original invoice showing the purchase date, your vehicle and the odometer reading.
  • Not covered: tyres worn to 1.6 mm, road hazards such as punctures and cuts, or wear caused by alignment, tyre pressure or the condition of the vehicle.
Goodyear's full warranty policy →

Tyre Protection Plan

Free with 2 or more Goodyear passenger tyres

Covers puncture repairs, impact fractures, accidental cuts and kerb damage. It's free with 2 or more Goodyear passenger tyres bought in the same transaction. Otherwise it's $11 per car tyre, or $16 per SUV, 4WD or ultra-light truck tyre, and it can only be bought with your tyres.

  • Lasts 4 years or 90,000 km, or until the tread is down to 1.6 mm or the tyres come off the car, whichever comes first.
  • If a tyre has to be replaced, you pay a pro rata amount for the tread already used, plus fitting.
  • Not available for run-flat or tubed tyres, multi-piece or split rims, or fleet and commercial accounts.
Full Tyre Protection Plan terms →

Mileage warranties

When you buy two or more of these tyres:

Goodyear Assurance DuraPlus 2Exclusive to Goodyear Autocare70,000 km
Goodyear Assurance MaxGuard and MaxGuard SUV80,000 km for 17" rims and below, 70,000 km for 18", 60,000 km for 19", 50,000 km for 20" and aboveUp to 80,000 km
Goodyear Wrangler All-Terrain AdventureDepends on tyre size and construction55,000 to 95,000 km

If a tyre wears evenly down to 1.6 mm before its warranted kilometres, you get a pro rata discount on an equivalent replacement. For example, a tyre that lasts half its warranted kilometres gets 50% off. Valid for 5 years from purchase. Not for commercial use or for tyres that came fitted to a new car.

Keep your warranty valid

  • Rotate and balance your tyres every 6 months or 10,000 km, whichever comes first (costs may apply).
  • Have your wheel alignment done as recommended.
  • Keep your tyre pressures to the placard on your car.
  • Keep your invoice, and get your service record stamped at every tyre service.

We do all of this here and stamp your service record every time.

Good to know

Questions? Answered.

Will a logbook service here affect my new-car warranty?

No. We service your car to the manufacturer's logbook schedule and stamp your logbook, so your new-car warranty stays intact.

What's included in a general service?

General services start from $129 and include an oil change with up to 4.8 litres of Penrite oil, a new oil filter, fluid top-ups and a full safety inspection. If your car takes more than 4.8 litres, the extra oil is charged on top, and so are any add-on parts it needs, like a cabin filter or air filter. We'll always check with you first.

How much is a pre-purchase inspection?

$70 for any Japanese car and $100 for any German car. For other makes we'll text or email you a quote. We check the engine, transmission, brakes, suspension, tyres, body and electrics, road test the car, and talk you through what we find.

Is the tyre inspection really free?

Yes. There's no inspection charge. Book a free inspection and we'll check your tyres' tread, wear, damage and pressures, then recommend the right brand and give you a price — no obligation.

How do I get a price?

Book online, use Find My Tyres, or send us a message. We'll text or email you a quote for your car before any work starts — no surprises.

How does the membership work?

Pay $850 once and get 6 general services (5 + the 6th free), 2 car washes and 2 pick-ups & drop-offs — over $1,000 of services at our normal prices. Every service includes a free tyre rotation. Members also get 10% off any extra parts and labour, a free wheel alignment with any set of 4 tyres, tyre cleaning for $25 a tyre, extra pick-ups for $10 and 10% off at Lazy Brunch. It's valid for 3 years, has no joining fee, and you can use the services on any car.

Can I buy tyres now and have them fitted later?

Yes — you can buy tyres now and have them fitted later. Members get a free wheel alignment when a set of 4 is fitted.

What if the part I need isn't in stock?

Sorry — it does happen. We'll source the part from our suppliers as quickly as we can, tell you how long it should take, and keep you updated. We'll always confirm the price with you before we order it.

How does pick-up and drop-off work?

We collect your car from home or work within 20 km of the workshop and bring it back when it's done. It's $10 for members and $20 for non-members.

Do you offer Afterpay and pensioner discounts?

Yes. Afterpay is available, and we offer discounts for seniors and pensioner card holders — just show your card.

How do roadworthy certificates (RWC) work?

A roadworthy is $145. Just drop your car off with us. In Tasmania, roadworthy inspections are done by an Approved Inspection Station (AIS), so the inspection is done at our partner workshop, which is an AIS, and we handle the paperwork for you.

Do you do air-conditioning?

Yes, through our partner workshop for now, and we're bringing it in-house soon. Book in and we'll organise it for you.

The fine print

Terms & conditions

These terms apply to all bookings, quotes, work and offers from Goodyear Auto Care Hobart, 94-96 Brisbane Street, Hobart TAS 7000 (Antilia Capital Pty Ltd trading as Boost Auto Hub). Please read them before you book. By booking with us, you agree to them. Nothing in these terms limits your rights under the Australian Consumer Law.

Quotes, estimates & prices
  • Prices on this website include GST. They're a guide only and may change. If a price on the website is wrong, we'll tell you before any work starts and you can choose not to go ahead.
  • Online estimates are not a final price. We confirm your quote by text or email once we know your vehicle, and after inspecting it where needed.
  • Labour is charged at $149 per hour (including GST) unless we quote a fixed price. Parts prices vary by vehicle.
  • Quotes are valid for 14 days unless we tell you otherwise.
  • We won't do any work beyond your approved quote, or spend more than the amount you approved, without contacting you first and getting your approval. If we can't reach you, we'll wait.
  • Finding the cause of a fault takes time. We'll tell you the estimated cost of diagnosis before we start, and it's payable even if you decide not to go ahead with the repair.
Bookings, authorisation & pick-up
  • An online booking is a request. It's only confirmed once we contact you.
  • Booking times are drop-off times. Completion times are estimates and can change if we find extra problems or parts are delayed. We'll keep you updated.
  • Please give us at least 24 hours' notice if you need to cancel or change a booking.
  • By leaving your vehicle with us, you authorise our qualified staff to inspect, move and road test it, including on public roads, as needed to do and check the work.
  • Tyre inspections are free of charge.
  • Pick-up and drop-off is available within 20 km of the workshop. The vehicle must be registered, roadworthy and safe to drive. We'll only drive it between your address, our workshop and, if your job needs it, a partner workshop or inspection station.
  • For special-order parts or tyres, we may ask for a deposit. If you cancel after we've ordered them, you only pay the costs we can't get back from the supplier (such as freight or restocking fees). We'll tell you about these costs before we order.
Your vehicle, condition & belongings
  • Please remove valuables and personal belongings before drop-off. We take reasonable care of your vehicle while we have it, but we're not responsible for items left in it unless the loss is caused by our negligence.
  • We're not responsible for pre-existing damage, wear and tear, or faults that aren't related to the work we do. We may note or photograph existing damage when you drop off.
  • Please tell us about any warning lights, known problems or modifications when you book.
  • On older vehicles, seized, rusted or brittle parts (such as bolts, clips, sensors and exhaust parts) can break during normal work. If this happens, we'll tell you before doing any extra work, and the cost of replacing them is charged to you.
  • Tyres: please have your wheel nuts re-checked after the first 100 km. Corroded or faulty tyre pressure sensors may need replacing at extra cost. We'll advise you first.
Parts & customer-supplied parts
  • We may use genuine or quality aftermarket parts that meet the manufacturer's specifications, so your new-car warranty stays intact.
  • Parts availability depends on our suppliers. If a part is out of stock or delayed, we'll let you know, source it as soon as we reasonably can and give you an updated timeframe. We're not responsible for delays caused by suppliers or freight.
  • Brake rotors are machined where possible. If a rotor is below the manufacturer's minimum thickness or is damaged, it must be replaced. This depends on its condition.
  • If you'd like your old parts back, please ask when you drop off. Otherwise we dispose of them responsibly. Some parts, such as batteries and exchange units, are returned to the supplier.
  • If you supply your own parts, we're not responsible for their quality, fit or suitability, or for faults they cause. Our workmanship still comes with the consumer guarantees. If your part fails or is wrong, refitting labour is charged at our normal rate.
Repair notice (given under the Australian Consumer Law)
  • Goods presented for repair may be replaced by refurbished goods of the same type rather than being repaired. Refurbished parts may be used to repair the goods.
  • Your vehicle may store data you've created, such as phone contacts, call history, navigation destinations and settings. Repairs to your vehicle may cause this data to be lost. Please back up or remove anything you want to keep before drop-off.
  • If we plan to use a refurbished or exchange part on your vehicle, we'll tell you when we quote.
Pre-purchase inspections & roadworthies
  • A pre-purchase inspection is a report on the condition of the vehicle at the time of inspection, based on what can reasonably be seen and tested. It is not a guarantee of future reliability and may not reveal hidden or intermittent faults.
  • A pre-purchase inspection is not a roadworthy inspection. It does not check the vehicle's finance, registration or ownership history. We recommend a PPSR check before you buy.
  • In Tasmania, roadworthy inspections can only be carried out by an Approved Inspection Station (AIS). Our roadworthy service is $145: drop off your car with us, the inspection is done at our partner workshop (an AIS), and we handle the transport and paperwork for you.
  • A passed inspection report is only issued if the vehicle meets the required standards on the day. If it doesn't, we'll give you a repair quote, and a re-inspection may cost extra.
Price beat
  • We'll do our best to beat a competitor's price, but a price beat is not guaranteed and is at our discretion.
  • You must show a genuine, current, written and itemised quote from a registered Australian business, dated within the last 7 days.
  • The quote must be for the identical product or service (same brand, model, size and specification) and include fitting and all fees.
  • Excludes online-only retailers, trade or wholesale pricing, clearance, second-hand, auction and stock that isn't available.
  • We may contact the other business to verify the quote. A price beat applies to that job only and can't be combined with any other discount, deal or membership offer.
Membership, deals & discounts
  • The $850 Boost Membership starts from 1 January 2027. It's valid for 3 years from purchase and is for the member named on the membership. It can't be transferred to another person without our agreement, but you can use the included services on any car you bring in.
  • The membership includes 6 general services (5 + the 6th free), 2 car washes and 2 pick-ups & drop-offs. Each service includes an oil change (up to 4.8 litres) and oil filter. Extra oil and any additional parts, such as cabin and air filters, are charged separately, with 10% off for members.
  • The member 10% discount applies to parts and labour outside the services included in the membership. It does not apply to tyres, which are sold at our normal price.
  • The free wheel alignment applies when a set of 4 tyres is bought from and fitted by us, one alignment per set. The free tyre rotation is done during a general service.
  • Unless stated, discounts and deals can't be combined. End-of-year deals end 31 December 2026. Senior and pensioner discounts require a valid card.
  • Unused services can't be exchanged for cash, except where required by law.
Payment, collection & storage
  • Payment is due when the work is completed, before the vehicle is released. Afterpay is available, subject to Afterpay's approval.
  • We may keep your vehicle until the account for the work you approved is paid in full. This is known as a repairer's lien.
  • Please collect your vehicle promptly once we tell you it's ready. If it isn't collected within 3 business days, we may charge a reasonable daily storage fee. We'll tell you the amount before it applies.
  • If a vehicle is left uncollected, we may deal with it under the Disposal of Uncollected Goods Act 2020 (Tas). This includes giving you written notice and, if the vehicle is still not collected and paid for, selling it to recover the amount owed, as the Act allows.
  • If an account isn't paid when it's due, we may refer it for collection, and you may have to pay our reasonable costs of recovering it.
Warranty & disputes
  • Our goods and services come with guarantees that cannot be excluded under the Australian Consumer Law. For major failures with the service, you are entitled: to cancel your service contract with us; and to a refund for the unused portion, or to compensation for its reduced value. You are also entitled to choose a refund or replacement for major failures with goods. If a failure with the goods or a service does not amount to a major failure, you are entitled to have the failure rectified in a reasonable time. If this is not done you are entitled to a refund for the goods and to cancel the contract for the service and obtain a refund of any unused portion. You are also entitled to be compensated for any other reasonably foreseeable loss or damage from a failure in the goods or service.
  • If you have a concern about our work, please contact us as soon as possible on (03) 6234 3787 or at hobart@goodyear.com.au, so we can inspect the vehicle and, if the problem is with our work, put it right.
  • We are not responsible for faults caused by misuse, accident, lack of maintenance, or work carried out by anyone else after our work.
  • Please support any claim with reasonable evidence, such as your invoice and photos, and make the vehicle available for us to inspect.
  • If we can't resolve a concern together, you can contact Consumer, Building and Occupational Services (CBOS) Tasmania or the Tasmanian Automobile Chamber of Commerce (TACC) for help.
  • Nothing in these terms excludes, restricts or modifies any right or remedy you have under the Australian Consumer Law.
